During Dem_Init the Dem initializes the monitor and component states. After this point in time, the Dem shall return E_OK on the APIs Dem_GetMonitorStatus and Dem_GetComponentFailed .
The Dem shall call FiM_DemInit after the monitor and component states have been initialized.
The monitor status shall be initialized within Dem_Init . Any call to Dem_GetMonitorStatus shall return E_NOT_OK if the monitor status is uninitialized.

Required DEM_EVENT_ASSOCIATED_IDENTIFICATION for events If an DemEvent refers an DemDTC that itself requires snapshot record or extended data records that contain a DemInternalDataElement = DEM_EVENT_ASSOCIATED_IDENTIFICATION , the DemEventAssociatedIdentification shall be configured for that event.

Usage of internal data elements only for extended data records The DemInternalDataElementClass shall be only allowed for DemDataElementClass if it is only referenced by DemDataElementClassRef from DemExtendedDataRecordClass .

Unique extended data record values within a single event memory All the DemExtendedDataRecordClass containers referenced from 71 of 536 Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R21-11 DTCs of one event memory shall have a distinct DemExtendedDataRecordNumber .
Unique snapshot record values within a single event memory All the DemFreezeFrameRecordClass containers referenced from DTCs of one event memory shall have a distinct DemFreezeFrameRecordNumber .
Limit OBD DTCs to primary fault memory A DemDTC shall only have a configured DemObdDTCRef if the DTC has a DemMemoryDestinationRef to DemPrimaryMemory .

Extended data record values for primary fault memory A DemExtendedDataRecordClass container referenced from a DTC assigned to the primary memory shall have DemExtendedDataRecordNumber in the range 0x01-0xEF.

Extended data record values for user defined event memory A DemExtendedDataRecordClass container referenced from a DTC assigned to a user defined memory shall have DemExtendedDataRecordNumber in the range 0x01-0xFD.
Prerequisites for use of DEM_IUMPR If an internal data element uses DEM_IUMPR the corresponding event shall be referenced by DemDiagnosticEventRef .
Prerequisites for use of DEM_DTR If an internal data element uses DEM_DTR the corresponding event shall be referenced by DemDtrEventRef .
DemUDSOBDFreezeFrameClassRef shall not be configured if DemPidClass is configured in a specific configuration variant.

3 Byte OBD DTC configuration only for OBD UDS DTC separation A 3 byte OBD DTC DemDtcValue3Byte shall be only configured if DemSupportedObdUdsDtcSeparation is set to TRUE and if DemOBDSupport is set to DEM_OBD_MASTER_ECU or DEM_OBD_PRIMARY_ECU .
2 Byte OBD DTC configuration without DTC separation A 2 byte OBD DTC DemDtcValue shall be only configured if DemSupportedObdUdsDtcSeparation is not configured or set to FALSE.
DemExtendedDataRecordTrigger needs to be configured. DemExtendedDataRecordTrigger shall always be configured, except for internal data elements like occurrence counters.

Limitations on DemMemoryDestinationRef A DTC can only reference the event memories via DemMemoryDestinationRef to the event memories of the same DemEventMemorySet . The scenario that a DTC references event memories via DemMemoryDestinationRef on different DemEventMemorySet is not supported.

Limited use of monitor status change callbacks to events reported from SW-Cs only If Dem_SetEventAvailable is called from a Cdd or BSW module, the corresponding monitor status changed callback can only be used as C-function, but not via RTE interface.

The error report functions Det_ReportError, Det_ReportTransient Fault and Det_ReportRuntimeError shall call immediately all configured Error_Hooks (see ECUC_Det_00010, ECUC_Det_00011).

Optional implementation specific functionality shall only be performed after all configured Error_Hooks (see ECUC_Det_00010 and ECUC_ Det_0011) have been called. Furthermore this functionality shall be pre-compile-time configurable
The Default Error Tracer shall execute the corresponding list of configured DetErrorHook (refer to ECUC_Det_00005) in the order given by the configuration.
The DET shall provide the initialization function Det_Init (see SWS_Det_00008).
Each call of the Det_Init function shall be used to set the Default Error Tracer to a defined initial status (e.g. by removing optional error recovery information).

If the Default Error Tracer has not been initialized before Det_ ReportTransientFault or Det_ReportRuntimeError reporting functions are called, these functions shall return immediately without any other action (no Error_Hook shall be used, no implementer specific function shall be performed and no error shall be reported).
The Default Error Tracer shall provide the function Det_Start (see SWS_Det_00010).
Det_ReportError shall stop execution. Ensure that DET runtime errors and DET transient faults are handled such that DET is not called recursively.
Each call of the Det_ReportError, Det_ReportTransientFault and Det_ReportRuntimeError function shall be forwarded to the DLT module, if this is available/configured.

Each Error_Hook shall be called with the same set of parameters as the corresponding functions Det_ReportError, Det_ReportTransientFault and Det_ReportRuntimeError. The configured callout functions are ECU configurations, see ECUC_DET_00005, ECUC_DET_00010 and ECUC_DET_00011
Det.h includes all user relevant information for the tracing of errors reported via its services.
The Det_ReportError, Det_ReportTransientFault and Det_Report RuntimeError functions shall be reentrant.
The DET shall notify the error DET_E_PARAM_POINTER to all functions configured in callouts in case a null pointer error occurs in Det_GetVersion Info.
if callout functions are configured, they should have the same signatures as the corresponding functions. If several callouts are defined for the same service they should have the same ID.
